positions.title: Applications Intern
positions.description:
▪️ Investigated federated learning approach to beam prediction problem in mmWave communication systems

positions.title: Ph.D. Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
▪️Worked on ML evaluation tools used for Ads personalization models in Facebook AI Infra team
▪️Improved the evaluation time from days to hours using multithreading and PyTorch JIT scripting
▪️Proposed and Implemented a tool that helps ML engineers to find an optimal quantization scheme

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
▪️ Designed and implemented an IoT device targeting system in Alexa Smart Home API
▪️ Deployed the system to production using tools for continuous integration, unit testing, and A/B testing
▪️ Participated in a hackathon to build Alexa custom skill connected with serverless web app using AWS services

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
▪️ Conducted individual research regarding parallel distributed machine learning (ML) in the edge network
▪️ Developed a Java application that simulates computational cost and loss of distributed ML in edge nodes
▪️ Proposed a scheme that optimizes ML in edge network by dynamically controlling the level of delay in terms of synchrony
▪️ Accepted as a paper for the International Conference on Parallel and Distributed Processing Techniques and Applications

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
▪️Participated in a project for on-loading spatiotemporal context in mobile devices using differential privacy
▪️Developed a front-end application for android implementation of contextual data on-loading architecture
▪️Implemented SQLite database and Google Maps API for querying ‘Z context’ in contextual data
